translations.web: Let all them be shamed who serve engraved images, who boast in their idols. Worship him, all you gods!
translations.bsb: All worshipers of images are put to shame— those who boast in idols. Worship Him, all you gods!
translations.kjv: Confounded be all they that serve graven images, that boast themselves of idols: worship him, all ye gods.
translations.asv: Let all them be put to shame that serve graven images, That boast themselves of idols: Worship him, all ye gods.
